name: gzip
description: Compresses each file on its own and replaces it with a .gz version: the original file disappears, unless -k is used. gzip does not bundle several files into one; for a directory, first create an archive with tar (tar -czf does both at once).

options.description: Writes the result to standard output without touching the files.
Compresses each file in directories, recursively.
Prints the compression ratio of each file.
Shows compressed size, original size and ratio.

arguments.name: FILE
arguments.description: File(s) to compress. Without a file: standard input.

examples.explanation: Maximum compression while keeping the original, with the ratio achieved.
Compresses a database backup on the fly.
